newsitem.title: USA: LCI Intl converts preferred stock.
newsitem.headline: LCI Intl converts preferred stock.

text.p: LCI International Inc said on Friday substantially all of the company's 4,600,000 shares of its 5 percent cumulative convertible exchangeable preferred stock have been converted into LCI common stock.
As a result of the conversions and redemption, the preferred stock stopped trading on the New York Stock Exchange at the close of business on August 30, 1996.
The preferred stock conversions have increased the common shares outstanding by over 12 million shares, the company said.
The preferred shares were figured into earnings per share calculations on a fully diluted basis, resulting in no impact on earnings per share, LCI said.
With the conversions and redemption, the company said it will save approximately $6 million in annual preferred dividends.
